fields.value: Realistic synthetic cable images and semantic segmentation masks dataset

dsDescriptionValue.value: The dataset contains the 25000 synthetic cable images and masks generated to train Deep Learning semantic segmentation models, as well as the weights of six segmentation models trained with them. This dataset is, related to the publication: Pablo Malvido Fresnillo, Wael M. Mohammed, Saigopal Vasudevan, Jose A. Perez Garcia, and Jose L. Martinez Lastra. "Generation of realistic synthetic cable images to train Deep Learning segmentation models." 2024.
